aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leaning into leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring scanner setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.
